column2: mature peptide of the segment A polyprotein, so being a 51% partial of POLY at 100% identity is its DEFINITION, not a truncation. The FRAGMENT test cannot separate a cleavage product from a truncated deposit; that was done at bin time by the literature window (480-560, IBDV 1-512 PMID 11836417, IPNV 1-508 PMID 10666235) and by junction chemistry, which rejected all 19 IPNV deposits that ran 4 residues past the real cut (ending P, because 509-512 is SGGP).

mature peptide of pVP2 and so a 44% partial of POLY by construction. Discriminated at bin time by the window (395-475: IBDV 1-441, IPNV 1-442) and by the end residue Ala, which excluded 47 deposits of the 452 aa recombinant VP2 boundary (PMID 12832770) and 7 of the 465 aa form. The 99.5% rather than 100% identity reflects strain variation between the VP2 deposits and the POLY members, not a mixed bin.

mature peptide of pVP2, 41-46 aa, so a 4% partial of POLY by construction. Window 36-52 and a measured N-terminal aromatic (IBDV F, IPNV W) from the A|[FW]G maturation cut, which is a DIFFERENT chemistry from the VP4 A|[AS] sites and so cannot be confused with them. Present in every genus (PMID 11836417, 17553791, 15269363).

mature peptide of the polyprotein in Blosnavirus and Telnavirus only, 58-120 aa, so a 7% partial of POLY by construction. Measured 18 Nov 2026: X has no blastp hit to VP2, VP4 or VP3 even at e-value 10, and the BSNV polyprotein tiles exactly without overlap, so this bin cannot be a fragment of a neighbouring feature. n=2 (one BSNV deposit plus a located TV-1 reference), which is a coverage limit recorded in the feature note, not a contamination finding.

mature peptide of the polyprotein, 165-320 aa, so a 23% partial of POLY by construction. Window and junction chemistry enforced at bin time (IBDV 513-755, IPNV 509-734 with catalytic Ser633/Lys674, PMID 10666235); the end residue Ala and start Ala/Ser were verified on the deposited polyproteins at those exact coordinates before the filter was applied. The one deposit that really was mis-bounded, a 268 aa record spanning IPNV 454-721, sits INSIDE the length window and is excluded by name in NOT_MODELLED.

mature peptide of the polyprotein, 215-310 aa, so a 25% partial of POLY by construction. Window 215-310 (IBDV 756-1012 = 257, IPNV 735-972 = 238) and a measured Ala/Ser start from the VP4/VP3 junction. Its C-terminus IS the polyprotein stop, so it is the one cleavage product whose end needs no cleavage-site test.

The pVP2 C-terminal maturation peptide pep11 (IBDV pVP2 442-512 releases pep46, pep7a, pep7b and pep11; PMID 11836417, 15269363). The SPLIT finding is an artefact of the length, not evidence of a mixed bin: at 11-13 aa a single substitution moves a member into its own cluster, so 11 sequences necessarily scatter into 5 groups at any identity floor a longer protein would use. NOT MODELLED -- no profile is built and the feature is absent from the module JSON, because a 13-residue PSSM cannot be made specific. The bin is retained as literature provenance for the pVP2 cleavage cassette.

The pVP2 C-terminal maturation peptide pep7a, same cassette and same citations as PEP11. 14 sequences of 7 and 9 aa; the 5 reported groups are what 7-mers do under any clustering. NOT MODELLED, for the same reason -- a 7-residue profile would match on chance alone. Retained as provenance.
The pVP2 C-terminal maturation peptide pep7b, same cassette and same citations as PEP11. 7 sequences, all exactly 7 aa; 4 groups. NOT MODELLED, same reason. Retained as provenance.
